candidate_profile.name: Bishoy Amgad
candidate_profile.professional_summary: 4th-year Computer and Information Sciences student at Ain Shams University with a strong background in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Agentic AI, seeking a training opportunity in Generative AI to deepen expertise in LLMs, RAG systems, and multi-agent architectures through hands-on real-world applications.

education.degree: Bachelor’s in Computer and Information Sciences
education.institution: Ain Shams University, Faculty of Computer and Information Sciences

projects.name: Mini-RAG System
projects.description: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline with a FastAPI backend, MongoDB for metadata storage, Qdrant as the vector database, and Cohere embeddings for semantic search, including document ingestion, chunking, async file handling, and LLM‑based answer generation.

projects.name: Job Hunt AI Agent
projects.description: Developed an AI agent that ingests a candidate’s CV, LinkedIn profile, and GitHub portfolio to automatically search and match relevant job opportunities, integrated with the Mini‑RAG system for data‑grounded responses.

projects.name: Multi-Modal RAG Platform
projects.description: Engineered a platform that ingests and indexes heterogeneous documents (PDF, Word, Excel, images) using OCR and multiple LangChain loaders, storing vectors in PostgreSQL with pgvector and exposing unified semantic search via a FastAPI backend.

projects.name: Loan Completion Status Prediction
projects.description: Built a 4‑class Random Forest classifier achieving 96.36% accuracy, using SMOTE for class balancing on a 1,810‑record dataset and deployed as an interactive Streamlit web app.

projects.name: Emotion Detection from Text
projects.description: Created a multi‑class text classifier to detect emotions using NLTK preprocessing, TF‑IDF vectorization, and scikit‑learn models.

projects.name: Flower Image Classification
projects.description: Engineered a CNN model for image recognition with data augmentation, leveraging TensorFlow, Keras, and OpenCV for preprocessing and training.
